# Map the Midterms

> Map the Midterms (mapthemidterms.com) is an independent, nonpartisan information site about U.S. elections other than presidential general elections. It archives the November 3, 2026 U.S. midterm elections — race guides for selected U.S. Senate, governor and U.S. House contests, published polls with links to their sources, sample-ballot outlines, key 2026 voting deadline dates (each cited to an official election office, state law or Vote.gov), and Associated Press-called results — and it publishes evergreen pages such as a 2027–2028 U.S. election calendar and civics explainers. It is not an official election website and does not endorse candidates. Confirm ballots, deadlines and voting rules with your state or county election office or Vote.gov. Results reported from the Associated Press stay unofficial until each state certifies them.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://mapthemidterms.com/): Overview of 2026 midterm election results and the site's voter-information tools.
- [Who won the 2026 elections](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/2026/): Archive of Associated Press-called 2026 Senate, House and governor winners. Races AP has not called are not listed yet. Vote counts are unofficial until a state certifies them.
- [Results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/): Results hub for the November 3, 2026 general election, with links to the who-won archive, state pages and majority explainers.
- [US election calendar 2027 and 2028](https://mapthemidterms.com/calendar/): Special elections, 2027 off-year elections and dated 2028 lines, each cited to a state election office, a statute or the FEC. A contest without a posted date is marked not yet announced.
- [Election explainers](https://mapthemidterms.com/learn/): Civics explainers, including how a House majority works and how a Senate majority works.
- [How the House majority works](https://mapthemidterms.com/learn/house-majority/): The House majority rule (218 of 435 seats), for readers asking who controls the House after the 2026 midterms.
- [How the Senate majority works](https://mapthemidterms.com/learn/senate-majority/): Senate majority rules, for readers asking who controls the Senate after the 2026 midterms.
- [2026 voting deadlines by state](https://mapthemidterms.com/voting-deadlines/): Registration, early voting and mail-ballot dates for 17 states, each linked to its official source. Election Day has passed; these dates are kept for reference.
- [Ballot lookup](https://mapthemidterms.com/ballot/): Sample-ballot outlines by ZIP code or state, with links to official election offices.
- [Race guides](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/): Index of the Senate, governor and House races covered, with sourced candidate details.
- [Polls](https://mapthemidterms.com/polls/): Published 2026 polls, each attributed to the pollster with a source link.

## Census places

- [U.S. Census places](https://mapthemidterms.com/cities/): Index of incorporated places and census-designated places from the U.S. Census Bureau 2026 Gazetteer national places file (file date September 8, 2026). Each place page title is the place name, state, and “2026 Elections: Candidates & Races”. The page lists 2026 general-election candidate names and parties only from an official state election-office list read for that state, or says the official list is not yet published. Texas place pages also list countywide November 3, 2026 offices copied from the Texas Secretary of State ballot certification for that general election, signed August 28, 2026 (https://www.sos.texas.gov/elections/forms/2026-ballot-cert.pdf). The certification lists precinct, justice of the peace, and judicial-district or court-of-appeals contests and does not identify which places are in each district, so those contests are not copied. The homepage and city indexes include a browser-only ZIP search built from Census ZCTA relationship files. State indexes are linked from that page. Individual place URLs are not listed in this file.

## Statewide results pages (Minnesota, Maine, Iowa, Alaska, Kansas)

These statewide result pages remain available. For the full set of Associated Press-called 2026 Senate, House and governor races, see [Who won the 2026 elections](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/2026/). Vote counts stay unofficial until each state certifies them. Candidate names on these pages came from each state's official general-election candidate list.

- [Minnesota U.S. Senate 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/mn-senate-2026/): Class 2 seat. Names from the Secretary of State candidate file. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/mn-senate-2026/).
- [Minnesota Governor 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/mn-governor-2026/): Governor and lieutenant governor tickets from the Secretary of State candidate file. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/mn-governor-2026/).
- [Maine U.S. Senate 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/me-senate-2026/): Class 2 seat. Ranked-choice voting applies to this federal general-election contest, per the Secretary of State. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/me-senate-2026/).
- [Maine Governor 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/me-governor-2026/): The candidate guide says this general election is decided by plurality. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/me-governor-2026/).
- [Iowa U.S. Senate 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/ia-senate-2026/): Class 2 seat. Names from the Secretary of State general-election candidate list. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/ia-senate-2026/).
- [Iowa Governor 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/ia-governor-2026/): Governor and lieutenant governor names from the Secretary of State general-election candidate list. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/ia-governor-2026/).
- [Alaska U.S. Senate 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/ak-senate-2026/): Class 2 seat. Ranked-choice voting, per the Division of Elections. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/ak-senate-2026/).
- [Alaska Governor 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/ak-governor-2026/): Governor and lieutenant governor. Ranked-choice voting, per the Division of Elections. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/ak-governor-2026/).
- [Kansas U.S. Senate 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/ks-senate-2026/): Class 2 seat. Names from the Secretary of State candidate list, 2026 General selection. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/ks-senate-2026/).
- [Kansas Governor 2026 results](https://mapthemidterms.com/results/ks-governor-2026/): Governor and lieutenant governor rows from the Secretary of State candidate list, 2026 General selection. [Race guide](https://mapthemidterms.com/races/ks-governor-2026/).
